properties.name: portless.name
properties.description: Hostname prefix for the Portless route. Defaults to spring.application.name.

properties.name: portless.state-dir
properties.description: Path to the Portless state directory. Auto-detected if not set.

properties.name: portless.min-port
properties.description: Minimum port number for random port allocation.

properties.name: portless.max-port
properties.description: Maximum port number for random port allocation.

properties.name: portless.force
properties.description: Force overwrite existing route for the same hostname.

properties.name: portless.tld
properties.description: Custom TLD for the proxy (e.g. 'test'). When set, proxy starts with --https --tld. Defaults to 'localhost' if not set.
